settings.definition_quote: We consider a set of $N$ arms ... Conditionally on the chosen arm $A_t$, she receives ... a random observation $X_t\in\mathbb R^d$ ... there exists a partition $G^*=\{G^*_1,\dots,G^*_K\}$ of $[N]$ into $K$ groups such that any two arms $a$ and $b$ are in the same group if and only if they share the same expectation ... a strategy $\pi$ fulfilling $\Pr_{\pi,\nu}(\hat{G} \sim G^*)\geqslant 1-\delta$ is said to be $\delta$-PAC

algorithms.name: ACB (Active Clustering with Bandit feedback; SRI + ADC)

symbols.Delta_sep: lower bound Delta on the minimal Euclidean distance between group centers

source.label: thm:LB
source.quote: There exists a numerical constant $c>0$, such that we have for any $\sigma>0$, any $\Delta >0$, any $d\geq 1$, any $\theta>0$, any $\delta\in(0,1/12)$, and any $N\geqslant 2K \geq 4$ such that $\mathcal{E}(\Delta,\theta,\sigma,N,K,d) \neq \emptyset$ $T^*(\delta,\mathcal{E}(\Delta,\theta,\sigma,N,K,d)) \geqslant cN+ c\frac{\sigma^2}{\Delta^2}\left[N\log\left(\frac{N}{\delta}\right) + \sqrt{dKN\log\left(\frac{N}{\delta}\right)}\right]$

results.notes: Paper's N (number of arms) mapped to canonical K; paper's K (groups) is n_groups. Lower bound on minimax worst-case expected budget; hard instances are Gaussian and balanced.

symbols.Delta_sep: lower bound Delta on the minimal distance between group centers

conditions: N >= 2K, K even, K divides N (paper's notation)

source.label: lemma:LB1
source.quote: If $N\geqslant 2K$, $K$ is even, $K$ divides $N$, and $\theta=1/K$, then for any $\delta\in(0,1)$, $T^*(\delta,\mathcal{E}(\Delta,\theta,\sigma,N,K,d)) \geqslant \frac{\sigma^2}{\Delta^2}N\kl\left(1-\delta,\frac{\delta}{N}\right)$

results.notes: Paper's kl definition in the lemma statement has a typo; interpreted as Bernoulli kl. Lemma B.10 proves a version with 2delta/N.

symbols.Delta_sep: lower bound Delta on the minimal distance between group centers

conditions: N >= 2K, K even, K divides N (paper's notation)

source.label: lemma:LB2
source.quote: If $N\geqslant 2K$, $K$ is even, $K$ divides $N$, and $\theta=1/K$, then for all $\delta\in(0,1/6)$, $T^*(\delta,\mathcal{E}(\Delta,\theta,\sigma,N,K,d)) \geqslant \frac{\sigma^2}{\Delta^2} \sqrt{\frac{dKN}{72} \kl\left(\frac{1}{3}-2\delta,\frac{4\delta}{N}\right)}$

results.notes: High-dimensional term; proved via Gaussian prior and reduction to batch two-sample testing.

symbols.Delta_sep: separation parameter Delta (environment has Delta_* >= Delta)
symbols.theta_bal: balancedness parameter theta (environment has theta_* >= theta)

conditions: environment in E(Delta,theta,sigma,N,K,d): Delta_* >= Delta, theta_* >= theta
tuning: ACB run with inputs delta, Delta, theta

source.label: thm:ACB:general
source.quote: Both the ACB (Algorithm~\ref{algo:ACB}) and its adaptive version ACB$^*$ (Algorithm~\ref{algo:ACB:3}) are $\delta$-PAC on $\mathcal{E}(\Delta,\theta,\sigma,N,K,d)$. ... For any environment $\nu$ in $\mathcal{E}(\Delta,\theta,\sigma,N,K,d)$, such that $\theta\geq \log(K)/N$, we have $\mathbb{E}_{ACB,\nu}[\tau_{ACB}]\leqslant cN+ c'A$

results.notes: ACB is delta-PAC. Theorem C.1 restates this ACB part. Paper's N -> K, paper's K -> n_groups.

bound.expression: K + sigma**2/Delta_sep**2*(K*log(K/delta) + sqrt(d*K*n_groups*log(K/delta)) + sqrt(d)*log(n_groups)/theta_bal) + log(n_groups/delta)/theta_bal + sigma**2/Delta_sep**2/theta_bal*log(n_groups/delta)*(sqrt(d) + log(log(K/delta)))

symbols.Delta_sep: separation parameter Delta (environment has Delta_* >= Delta)

tuning: ACB run with inputs delta, Delta, theta
results.notes: Theorem C.1 gives B with loglog(1/(theta*delta)) instead of loglog(N/delta).

symbols.Delta_sep: separation parameter Delta of the class (Delta_* >= Delta)
symbols.theta_bal: balancedness parameter theta of the class

tuning: ACB* run with input delta only
results.notes: ACB* adaptive to Delta_* and theta_*; also delta-PAC.

bound.expression: K + sigma**2/(Delta_star**2*theta_star)*L_star*log(L_star*n_groups/delta)*(log(n_groups) + sqrt(d) + log(log(L_star)) + log(log(K/delta))) + L_star/theta_star*log(L_star*n_groups/delta) + sigma**2/Delta_star**2*(K*log(K/delta) + sqrt(d*K*n_groups*log(K/delta)))

symbols.Delta_star: minimal Euclidean distance between distinct group centers of the instance
symbols.theta_star: balancedness of the instance (proportion of arms in the smallest group)

tuning: ACB* run with input delta only

source.label: thm:ACB:adaptive
source.quote: Let $\delta>0$. For any environment $\nu$, ACB$^*$ Algorithm~\ref{algo:ACB:3} is $\delta$-PAC. There exist positive numerical constants $c$, $c'$, and $c''$ such that the following holds. $\mathbb{P}_{ACB^*,\nu}\Big[\tau_{ACB^*} \leqslant cN + c'\frac{\sigma^2}{\Delta_*^2\theta_*}L_*\log\left(\frac{L_*K}{\delta}\right)\left[\log(K)+ \sqrt{d}+\log\log(L_*)+ \log\log(N/\delta)\right] +c' \frac{L_*}{\theta_*}\log\left(\frac{L_*K}{\delta}\right)+c''\frac{\sigma^2}{\Delta_*^2}\left[N\log\left(N/\delta\right)+\sqrt{dNK\log\left(N/\delta\right)}\right]\Big]\geq 1-\delta$

results.notes: Instance-dependent version (in terms of Delta_*, theta_*) of the ACB* bound.
